name: my-workflow
description: A spec-driven software workflow for Claude Code and GitHub Copilot that keeps a human in control of agent-written code. drive-spec decides the kind of task (feature, bug or improvement), keeps specs/<task>/workflow.yaml and runs that kind's steps through the spec-* skills: spec-requirements or spec-diagnose, spec-design, spec-plan, spec-implement and spec-review. Every story, criterion, functionality, design unit and workaround has a stable id; scripts/spec-check.py decides the gates and writes a coverage report (planned, implemented, tested, passing per id); you approve the requirements, the design, and any workaround or waiver. Steps also work alone without a spec. The spec-architect, spec-tester, spec-implementer and spec-reviewer agents join when they pay off. Standalone skills: rephrase, discuss, audit-truth (a unit atlas of existing code: build, query, distill), scaffold-project-structure, design-component, analyze-ui-state. code-auditor builds an atlas as a session agent.
